theorem_title: Size of the unlabelled YAH certificate
natural_language_statement:
Let $R$ be the displayed list of unlabelled YAH instances and let $C$ be the list pairing those instances with the specified natural multipliers. Then

$$|R|=13\quad\text{and}\quad|C|=13.$$

Lengths count list entries. This records the exact size of the finite data used in the unlabelled adjacent-edge obstruction.
